verdict.rationale: Crossmint's commerce interfaces are proprietary REST APIs gated by API keys/signup (crossmint-docs-21, crossmint-docs-19), and a probe for a public OpenAPI/versioned spec came back 404 on all candidate paths (crossmint-probe-2). While Crossmint integrates with third-party open protocols like x402 and MPP, there is no evidence Crossmint itself publishes an open, versioned commerce protocol spec implementable without signing up.
